column5: Gap real (4th-grade factors-and-multiples only mentions GCF in passing; discrete-math divisibility-and-gcd is college level). All arithmetic rechecked (GCF/LCM of 12,18 and 4,6 and 24,36; 1/12+1/18=5/36; GCF*LCM=product). Prereqs/builds-toward exist; stage matches prealgebra.

All decimals/squares rechecked (22/7=3.142857, 1.41^2=1.9881, 1.42^2=2.0164, 27/99=3/11, 18/99=2/11). Prereqs/edges exist.

Gap real (HL only mentioned in tangent-lines-to-circles and triangle-congruence-sas). Q2 explanation called HL "the one case of SSA that always works"; false, SSA also determines the triangle when the given angle is obtuse or the side opposite it is the longer given side. Changed to "a case". 5-12-13 and tangent-segment proof checked. Prereqs/edge exist.

Gap real (circle-basics defines secants; no arc-angle rules for inside/outside vertices). Traced both proofs (chord BC: exterior angle APB of triangle BPC = DBC + ACB; secant case exterior angle = P + near inscribed angle). Numbers 90, 40, 70, two-tangent 180-m all correct. Prereqs exist.

Gap real (EVT/closed-interval method absent from calculus-1 except one mention in IVT). x^3-3x on [0,2]: f(0)=0, f(1)=-2, f(2)=2, f'(2)=9 checked; EVT and Fermat statements match Stewart 4.1. Prereqs/edges exist; stages consistent.

Gap real (no cosh/sinh in any calculus/precalc/DE file). Verified definitions, cosh^2-sinh^2=1 expansion, sinh2x, cosh2x=cosh^2+sinh^2, derivatives, tanh'=sech^2, arsinh y=ln(y+sqrt(y^2+1)), catenary a cosh(x/a), y''=y solution; matches Stewart 3.11. Prereqs/edges exist.

Gap real (no quadric/hyperboloid text elsewhere in calc or linear algebra). Core Idea said "every nondegenerate quadric fits one of six types": the elliptic cone is degenerate (singular) in the standard classification and cylinders are also quadrics, so reworded to "not a cylinder or a degenerate case" and noted traces may be degenerate conics (Stewart 12.6 lists the same six). Checked traces in Q1 (1+k^2), Q3 saddle, Q4, two-sheet empty band |z|<c. Prereqs/edge exist.

Gap real (no Bernoulli text in differential-equations). Rederived v=y^(1-n) linear form; Q1 -v'/2+2v=x; y'+y=y^2 -> y=1/(1+Ce^x) verified by substitution; logistic -> v'+rv=r/K verified; y=0 lost for n>0. Named for Jacob Bernoulli (1695) per standard references. Prereqs exist.

Gap real (one mention in ordinary-and-singular-points). Verified all three indicial equations (r^2-3r+2, (r+1)^2, r^2+1), x=e^t chain rule (x^2y''=y_tt-y_t) giving a y''+(b-a)y'+cy=0, complex-root form, |x| for x<0. Prereqs/edge exist.

Gap real (only a mention in sequential-compactness-metric-spaces). (1) Core Idea called the iff compactness criterion "equivalent" to the one-direction subsequence statement; changed to "In its full form". (2) builds-toward existence-uniqueness-ode removed: that topic is formal-systems stage and Picard-only (no Peano), so an advanced->formal-systems edge points backward; orchestrator should drop proposed edge arzela-ascoli-theorem->existence-uniqueness-ode. Checked theorem vs Rudin 7.25, x^n and bump counterexamples, MVT Lipschitz equicontinuity, diagonal proof sketch, Peano and compact integral operators.

Gap real (only implicit-function-theorem-on-manifolds exists; IFT cited in exponential-map). Verified statement vs Rudin 9.24, polar Jacobian r, complex-exp Jacobian e^{2x} and 2pi non-injectivity, x^3 counterexample, contraction map phi(x)=x+Df(a)^-1(y-f(x)) with derivative I-Df(a)^-1Df(x), implicit theorem via (x,F(x,y)). Prereqs/edges exist.

Gap real (Schwarz absent from complex-analysis). Verified lemma and equality case (Stein-Shakarchi 8.2.1), g=f/z proof, z^2 derivative example, phi_a properties and inverse phi_{-a}, h o phi_{-a} automorphism argument, Q4 option (z-1/2)/(1+z/2) at -0.9 = -2.545. Prereqs/edge exist.

Gap real (absent from graph). Q4 explanation said composing the square-root map with automorphisms gives a self-map of the disk with |derivative at 0|<1; the square root is not defined on the whole disk, the self-map is squaring composed with automorphisms (old map = that self-map after the new map). Rewrote. Verified Riemann 1851 thesis, Liouville exclusion of C, annulus modulus R/r criterion, Cayley map and inverse i(1+w)/(1-w), uniqueness via Schwarz, Montel/Hurwitz proof outline. Prereqs exist.

Gap real (no general transformation topic; probability integral transform alone is in uniform-distribution-theory). Verified -ln U ~ Exp(1), f_{2X}=(1/2)f_X(y/2), Z^2 density phi(sqrt y)/sqrt y = (2 pi y)^{-1/2} e^{-y/2} = chi-square(1), monotone formula and sign cancellation, F(X) uniform (Casella-Berger 2.1). Prereqs/edge exist.

Verified against Folland 3.15-3.20 and 3.35: Vitali finite covering with 3x enlargement, weak (1,1) constant 3^n, Mf non-integrable unless f=0 a.e., density/approximation argument, Lebesgue points, FTC for L^1, AC characterization, Cantor function.
